# eBay UK
> UK online marketplace for buying and selling electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles, home goods, and more.

eBay UK connects buyers and sellers across fixed-price listings, auctions, refurbished products, vehicle parts, and local collection. The site also provides account management, seller tools, help resources, and personalised shopping features through My eBay.

## Marketplace
- [eBay UK Home](https://www.ebay.co.uk): Main UK marketplace homepage for browsing products, categories, auctions, and featured offers.
- [Deals](https://www.ebay.co.uk/deals): Curated discounts across electronics, home, beauty, fashion, toys, and seasonal promotions.
- [Fashion](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/bn_7000259675): Fashion category hub for clothing, shoes, accessories, and branded styles.
- [Local Collection](https://www.ebay.co.uk/localcollection): Information about collecting eligible items locally from sellers.
- [Local Shopping](https://www.ebay.co.uk/vlp/local): Location-based marketplace view for nearby listings and collection options.

## Buying
- [Watchlist](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/watchlist): Track saved items, auctions, and listings you want to monitor.
- [Bids & Offers](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/bidsoffers): Review active bids, offers sent, and offer responses.
- [Purchase History](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/purchase): View completed orders, order details, and past purchases.
- [Recently Viewed](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/rvi): Return to listings and products you recently browsed.
- [Saved Feed](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/saved): Personalised feed of saved items, interests, and recommendations.
- [Saved Searches](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/savedsearches): Manage saved searches and listing alerts for specific queries.
- [Saved Sellers](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/savedsellers): Follow favourite sellers and access their latest listings.

## My eBay
- [My eBay](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mys/home?source=GBH): Main account area for buying, selling, and activity management.
- [Summary](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/summary): Overview of account activity, orders, selling, and recent marketplace updates.
- [Preferences](https://www.ebay.co.uk/d/myebay/preferences): Manage account settings, notifications, addresses, and communication preferences.
- [Watch List](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/watchlist): Access your tracked items and auction watch activity.
- [Saved Items](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/saved): Central place for saved listings and personalised shopping content.

## Selling
- [Sell](https://www.ebay.co.uk/sl/sell): Start creating a listing to sell an item on eBay UK.
- [Selling Overview](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mys/home?CurrentPage=MyeBayAllSelling&ssPageName=STRK:ME:LNLK:MESX&source=GBH): Seller dashboard for active listings, orders, and selling performance.
- [My eBay Selling Home](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mys/home?source=GBH): Seller account home for managing inventory and sales activity.
- [Register](https://signup.ebay.co.uk/pa/crte): Create an eBay account to buy, sell, and manage listings.

## Vehicles & Parts
- [My Garage](https://www.ebay.co.uk/g/mygarage): Save vehicle details to find compatible parts and accessories.
- [Cars, Motorcycles & Vehicles](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/Cars-Motorcycles-Vehicles/9800/bn_1865334): Vehicle marketplace for cars, bikes, parts, and accessories.
- [Vehicle Parts & Accessories](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/Vehicle-Parts-Accessories/6030/bn_1865336): Browse replacement parts, tools, and accessories for many vehicle types.
- [Local Collection for Vehicles](https://www.ebay.co.uk/localcollection): Collection options relevant to eligible larger or local-pickup items.

## Categories
- [Electronics](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/Electronics/bn_7000259124): Consumer electronics category including phones, computing, audio, and accessories.
- [Fashion](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/bn_7000259675): Clothing, footwear, jewellery, watches, and fashion accessories.
- [Collectables](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/Collectables/bn_7000259856): Collectibles category for memorabilia, trading cards, coins, and hobby items.
- [Home, Furniture & DIY](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/Home-Furniture-DIY/11700/bn_1853126): Home improvement, furniture, kitchenware, and household essentials.
- [Sporting Goods](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/Sporting-Goods/888/bn_1865031): Equipment, apparel, and accessories for fitness and outdoor activities.
- [Toys & Games](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/Toys-Games/220/bn_1865299): Toys, games, puzzles, and hobby products for different age groups.

## Account Access
- [Sign In](https://signin.ebay.co.uk/ws/eBayISAPI.dll?SignIn&sgfl=gh): Sign in to access buying, selling, and account management features.
- [Register](https://signup.ebay.co.uk/pa/crte): Create a new eBay UK account.
- [My eBay Summary](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/summary): Entry point for signed-in account activity and personalised tools.
- [Preferences](https://www.ebay.co.uk/d/myebay/preferences): Update account settings and personal preferences.

## Help & Support
- [Help & Contact](https://www.ebay.co.uk/help/home): Help centre for buying, selling, returns, payments, and account issues.
- [Buying Help](https://www.ebay.co.uk/help/buying): Support articles for purchasing, bidding, offers, and checkout.
- [Selling Help](https://www.ebay.co.uk/help/selling): Guidance for listing items, managing sales, and seller policies.
- [Returns & Refunds Help](https://www.ebay.co.uk/help/buying/returns-refunds): Help with returns, refunds, and resolving order problems.
- [Account Help](https://www.ebay.co.uk/help/account): Support for sign-in, profile settings, and account security.

## Personalisation
- [Recently Viewed](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/rvi): Revisit products and listings you have recently opened.
- [Saved Searches](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/savedsearches): Maintain search alerts for products, brands, and categories.
- [Saved Sellers](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/savedsellers): Keep track of preferred sellers and their inventory.
- [My Garage](https://www.ebay.co.uk/g/mygarage): Personalise vehicle shopping with saved car compatibility details.
